{"reasoning":"The defendant was a business employee who abused his position to issue false delivery orders, used the company seal without financial approval, and took company goods to sell for personal debts. This is the classic case of abusing a position to illegally appropriate company property, which under Chinese criminal law is classified as \"职务侵占\" (occupying by a person in a position). No other elements such as fraud, illegal manufacturing, or violent offenses are present.", "final_answer":"[罪名]职务侵占<eoa>"}
